faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes, whenever a chair is free. Booking ahead guarantees your time, especially on Fridays and Saturdays, which fill up fast.

faqs.question: How long does a haircut take?
faqs.answer: Plan on 45 minutes for most cuts. We would rather take our time than send you out with a line that is not quite straight.

faqs.question: Do you cut kids' hair?
faqs.answer: Gladly. Kids under 12 get their own price, and we keep a booster seat by the first chair.

faqs.question: What if I need to cancel?
faqs.answer: Call us at least four hours ahead and there is no charge. We just ask so someone else can take the chair.

art_direction.identity: A classic barbershop after dark: warm charcoal canvas, bone-white type, tungsten-lit photography of leather chairs, fades, and hot towel shaves. Square corners and hairline rules, like joinery and signwriting. Restraint over decoration.
art_direction.type: Barlow Condensed, uppercase and semibold, for every heading; Hanken Grotesk for all running text. Headlines are big and tight; body copy stays calm.
art_direction.color: One accent: polished brass (bg-primary / text-primary) for the main call to action, prices, one line of the hero headline, and the quote tile. Everything else is charcoal canvas, surface, bone ink, and muted text. Never add a second color.
art_direction.signature: The price board — services typeset like the shop's painted price list inside a double hairline frame, with dotted leaders running to brass prices. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Dry, confident, and specific. Short sentences. Old-trade pride without the costume. No exclamation points, no hype.
